slides.title: One matrix, two views
slides.steps: Open the normal loopback UI at its initial 2I matrix.
slides.expected: Both basis vectors and the transformed square appear. det A = 4; column u is selected.
slides.observed: Both basis vectors and the transformed square appear. det A = 4; column u is selected.

slides.title: Exact numeric entries
slides.steps: Enter 1.25, 0.5, 0.25, 2 in row-major order; Apply entries.
slides.expected: The new frame uses those entries. The last edited column v is selected in both views; det A = 2.375.
slides.observed: The new frame uses those entries. The last edited column v is selected in both views; det A = 2.375.

slides.title: Move the basis
slides.steps: Click u’s plotted endpoint, press Right, then Shift+Up.
slides.expected: u moves by (0.1, 0.01), entries become 1.35 and 0.26, det A = 2.57, and keyboard focus stays on u.
slides.observed: u moves by (0.1, 0.01), entries become 1.35 and 0.26, det A = 2.57, and keyboard focus stays on u.

slides.title: One shared undo history
slides.steps: Undo the two keyboard moves and the numeric edit, in that order.
slides.expected: The initial matrix, geometry and determinant return together. Three redo steps are available.
slides.observed: The initial matrix, geometry and determinant return together. Three redo steps are available.

slides.title: A singular frame stays editable
slides.expected: The square collapses onto a line; det A = 0. The UI explains that no inverse exists and offers recovery.
slides.observed: The square collapses onto a line; det A = 0. The UI explains that no inverse exists and offers recovery.

slides.title: Recover with a key
slides.steps: Focus v and press Up once.
slides.expected: The basis becomes independent again: v=(1,1.1), det A = 0.2. The singular edit was never snapped or discarded.
slides.observed: The basis becomes independent again: v=(1,1.1), det A = 0.2. The singular edit was never snapped or discarded.

slides.title: Zero vectors remain reachable
slides.steps: Apply the zero matrix; focus each separate basis button.
slides.expected: Both controls remain reachable even though their plotted endpoints coincide. det A = 0; recovery remains available.
slides.observed: Both controls remain reachable even though their plotted endpoints coincide. det A = 0; recovery remains available.

slides.title: Near singular, without a jump
slides.expected: det A = 0.001 and a near-singular explanation appears. All three decimals remain unchanged.
slides.observed: det A = 0.001 and a near-singular explanation appears. All three decimals remain unchanged.

slides.title: A failed drawing preserves the matrix
slides.steps: Block the local render request, then move u upward.
slides.expected: The committed entry is 0.1 and Undo remains available. Stale geometry and metrics are hidden; Retry drawing is offered.
slides.observed: The committed entry is 0.1 and Undo remains available. Stale geometry and metrics are hidden; Retry drawing is offered.

slides.title: Narrow layout, same matrix
slides.steps: At 390×844, apply the same collinear columns.
slides.expected: The two cards stack without horizontal scrolling. Numeric entries, basis controls and singular recovery remain available.
slides.observed: The two cards stack without horizontal scrolling. Numeric entries, basis controls and singular recovery remain available.

slides.title: Narrow keyboard recovery
slides.steps: Focus v and press Down on the narrow layout.
slides.expected: v becomes (1,0.9); det A = −0.2. Focus and shared column selection survive the render.
slides.observed: v becomes (1,0.9); det A = −0.2. Focus and shared column selection survive the render.
